en.create.ponder.belt_transport.text_1: Moving belts will transport Items and other Entities
en.create.ponder.belt_transport.text_2: Right-Click with an empty hand to take items off a belt
en.create.ponder.blaze_burner.text_1: Blaze Burners can provide Heat to Items processed in a Basin
en.create.ponder.blaze_burner.text_2: For this, the Blaze has to be fed with flammable items
en.create.ponder.blaze_burner.text_3: With a Blaze Cake, the Burner can reach an even stronger level of heat
en.create.ponder.blaze_burner.text_4: The feeding process can be automated using Deployers or Mechanical Arms
en.create.ponder.brass_funnel.text_1: Andesite Funnels can only ever extract single items.
en.create.ponder.brass_funnel.text_2: Brass Funnels can extract up to a full stack.
en.create.ponder.brass_funnel.text_3: The value panel allows for precise control over the extracted stack size.
en.create.ponder.brass_funnel.text_4: Using items on the filter slot will restrict the funnel to only transfer matching stacks.
en.create.ponder.brass_tunnel.text_1: Brass Tunnels can be used to cover up your belts
en.create.ponder.brass_tunnel.text_2: Brass Tunnels have filter slots on each open side
en.create.ponder.brass_tunnel.text_3: Filters on inbound connections simply block non-matching items
en.create.ponder.brass_tunnel.text_4: Filters on outbound connections can be used to sort items by type
en.create.ponder.brass_tunnel.text_5: Whenever a passing item has multiple valid exits, the distribution mode will decide how to handle it
en.create.ponder.brass_tunnel.text_6: Brass Tunnels on parallel belts will form a group
en.create.ponder.brass_tunnel.text_7: Incoming Items will now be distributed across all connected exits
en.create.ponder.brass_tunnel.text_8: For this, items can also be inserted into the Tunnel block directly
en.create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.header: Distribution Modes of the Brass Tunnel
en.create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_1: The distribution behaviour of Brass Tunnels can be configured
en.create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_10: 'Synchronize Inputs' is a unique setting for Brass Tunnels
en.create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_11: Items are only allowed past if every tunnel in the group has one waiting
en.create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_12: This ensures that all affected belts supply items at the same rate
en.create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_2: 'Split' will attempt to distribute the stack evenly between available outputs
en.create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_3: If an output is unable to take more items, it will be skipped
en.create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_4: 'Forced Split' will never skip outputs, and instead wait until they are free
en.create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_5: 'Round Robin' keeps stacks whole, and cycles through outputs iteratively
en.create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_6: Once Again, if an output is unable to take more items, it will be skipped
en.create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_8: 'Prefer Nearest' prioritizes the outputs closest to the items' input location
en.create.ponder.brass_tunnel_modes.text_9: 'Randomize' will distribute whole stacks to randomly picked outputs
en.create.ponder.cart_assembler.text_1: Powered Cart Assemblers mount attached structures to passing Minecarts
en.create.ponder.cart_assembler.text_2: Without a redstone signal, it disassembles passing cart contraptions back into blocks
en.create.ponder.cart_assembler.text_3: Using a Wrench on the Minecart will let you carry the Contraption elsewhere
en.create.ponder.cart_assembler_dual.text_1: Whenever two Cart Assemblers share an attached structure...
en.create.ponder.cart_assembler_dual.text_2: Powering either of them will create a Carriage Contraption
en.create.ponder.cart_assembler_dual.text_3: The carts will behave like those connected via Minecart Coupling
en.create.ponder.cart_assembler_modes.text_: Cart Contraptions will rotate to face towards their carts' motion
This Arrow indicates which side of the Structure will be considered the front
If the Assembler is set to Lock Rotation, the contraptions' orientation will never change
en.create.ponder.cart_assembler_rails.heade: Other types of Minecarts and Rails
en.create.ponder.cart_assembler_rails.text_: Cart Assemblers on Regular Tracks will not affect the passing carts' motion
When on Powered or Controller Rail, the carts will be held in place until it's Powered
Other types of Minecarts can be used as the anchor
Furnace Carts will keep themselves powered, pulling fuel from any attached inventories
en.create.ponder.chain_conveyor.header: Relaying rotational force using Chain Conveyors
en.create.ponder.chain_conveyor.text_1: Right-click two conveyors with chains to connect them
en.create.ponder.chain_conveyor.text_2: Chain conveyors relay rotational power between each other..
en.create.ponder.chain_conveyor.text_3: ..and connect to shafts above or below them
en.create.ponder.chain_conveyor.text_4: Right-click holding a wrench to start travelling on the chain
en.create.ponder.chain_conveyor.text_5: At a junction, face towards a chain to follow it
en.create.ponder.chain_drive.header: Relaying rotational force with Chain Drives
en.create.ponder.chain_drive.text_1: Chain Drives relay rotation to each other in a row
en.create.ponder.chain_drive.text_2: All shafts connected like this will rotate in the same direction
en.create.ponder.chain_drive.text_3: Any part of the row can be rotated by 90 degrees
en.create.ponder.chain_gearshift.header: Controlling rotational speed with Chain Gearshifts
en.create.ponder.chain_gearshift.text_1: Unpowered Chain Gearshifts behave exactly like Chain Drives
en.create.ponder.chain_gearshift.text_2: When Powered, the speed transmitted to other Chain Drives in the row is doubled
en.create.ponder.chain_gearshift.text_3: Whenever the Powered Gearshift is not at the source, its speed will be halved instead
en.create.ponder.chain_gearshift.text_4: In both cases, Chain Drives in the row always run at 2x the speed of the Powered Gearshift
en.create.ponder.chain_gearshift.text_5: Using analog signals, the ratio can be adjusted more precisely between 1 and 2
en.create.ponder.chute.text_1: Chutes can transport items vertically from and to inventories
en.create.ponder.chute.text_2: Using the Wrench, a window can be created
en.create.ponder.chute.text_3: Using Industrial Iron Blocks, chutes can be encased
en.create.ponder.chute.text_4: Placing chutes targeting the side faces of another will make it diagonal
en.create.ponder.chute_upward.text_1: Using Encased Fans at the top or bottom, a Chute can move items upward
en.create.ponder.chute_upward.text_2: Inspecting chutes with Engineers' Goggles reveals information about the movement direction
en.create.ponder.chute_upward.text_3: On the 'blocked' end, items will have to be inserted/taken from the sides
en.create.ponder.clockwork_bearing.text_1: Clockwork Bearings attach to blocks in front of them
en.create.ponder.clockwork_bearing.text_2: Upon receiving Rotational Force, the structure will be rotated according to the hour of the day
en.create.ponder.clockwork_bearing.text_5: Right-Click the bearing to start or stop animating the structure
en.create.ponder.clockwork_bearing.text_6: In front of the Hour Hand, a second structure can be added
en.create.ponder.clockwork_bearing.text_7: Ensure that the two Structures are not glued to each other
en.create.ponder.clockwork_bearing.text_8: The Second Structure will now rotate as the Minute Hand
en.create.ponder.clutch.header: Controlling rotational force using a Clutch
en.create.ponder.clutch.text_1: Clutches will relay rotation in a straight line
en.create.ponder.clutch.text_2: When powered by Redstone, it breaks the connection
en.create.ponder.cog_speedup.text_1: Large and Small cogs can be connected diagonally
en.create.ponder.cog_speedup.text_2: Shifting from large to small cogs, the conveyed speed will be doubled
en.create.ponder.cog_speedup.text_3: Shifting the opposite way, the conveyed speed will be halved
en.create.ponder.cogwheel.text_1: Cogwheels will relay rotation to other adjacent cogwheels
en.create.ponder.cogwheel.text_2: Neighbouring shafts connected like this will rotate in opposite directions
en.create.ponder.cogwheel_casing.text_1: Brass or Andesite Casing can be used to decorate Cogwheels
en.create.ponder.cogwheel_casing.text_2: Components added after encasing will not connect to the shaft outputs
en.create.ponder.cogwheel_casing.text_3: The Wrench can be used to toggle connections
en.create.ponder.contraption_controls.text_: Actors on moving contraptions are always active by default
Contraption Controls can be used to toggle them on the fly
They can be attached anywhere on the contraption
While disassembled, the filter can be changed to target specific types of actors
If it is redstone-activated during assembly...
...targeted actors will be turned off from the start
en.create.ponder.creative_fluid_tank.text_1: Creative Fluid Tanks can be used to provide a bottomless supply of fluid
en.create.ponder.creative_fluid_tank.text_2: Right-Click with a fluid containing item to configure it
en.create.ponder.creative_fluid_tank.text_3: Pipe Networks can now endlessly draw the assigned fluid from the tank
en.create.ponder.creative_fluid_tank.text_4: Any Fluids pushed back into a Creative Fluid Tank will be voided
en.create.ponder.creative_motor.header: Generating Rotational Force using Creative Motors
en.create.ponder.creative_motor.text_1: Creative motors are a compact and configurable source of Rotational Force
en.create.ponder.creative_motor.text_2: The generated speed can be configured on its input panels
en.create.ponder.creative_motor_mojang.head: Mojang's Enigma
en.create.ponder.crushing_wheels.text_1: A pair of Crushing Wheels can grind items very effectively
en.create.ponder.crushing_wheels.text_2: Their Rotational Input has to make them spin into each other
en.create.ponder.crushing_wheels.text_3: Items thrown or inserted into the top will get processed
en.create.ponder.crushing_wheels.text_4: Items can be inserted and picked up through automated means as well
en.create.ponder.deployer.text_1: Given Rotational Force, a Deployer can imitate player interactions
en.create.ponder.deployer.text_10: Right-click the front to give it an Item to use
en.create.ponder.deployer.text_11: Items can also be inserted automatically
en.create.ponder.deployer.text_13: When a filter is set, it activates only while holding a matching item
en.create.ponder.deployer.text_14: Only items matching the filter can now be inserted...
en.create.ponder.deployer.text_15: ...and only non-matching items will be extracted
en.create.ponder.deployer.text_2: It will always interact with the position 2 blocks in front of itself
en.create.ponder.deployer.text_3: Blocks directly in front will not obstruct it
en.create.ponder.deployer_contraption.text_: Whenever Deployers are moved as part of an animated Contraption...
They activate at each visited location, using items from inventories anywhere on the contraption
The Filter slot can be used to specify which items to pull
en.create.ponder.deployer_modes.text_1: By default, a Deployer imitates a Right-click interaction
en.create.ponder.deployer_modes.text_2: Using a Wrench, it can be set to imitate a Left-click instead
en.create.ponder.deployer_processing.text_1: With a fitting held item, Deployers can process items provided beneath them
en.create.ponder.deployer_processing.text_2: The Input items can be dropped or placed on a Depot under the Deployer
en.create.ponder.deployer_processing.text_3: When items are provided on a belt...
en.create.ponder.deployer_processing.text_4: The Deployer will hold and process them automatically
en.create.ponder.deployer_redstone.text_1: When powered by Redstone, Deployers will not activate
en.create.ponder.deployer_redstone.text_2: Before stopping, the Deployer will finish any started cycles
en.create.ponder.deployer_redstone.text_3: Thus, a negative pulse can be used to trigger exactly one activation cycle
en.create.ponder.depot.text_1: Depots can serve as 'stationary' belt elements
en.create.ponder.depot.text_2: Right-Click to manually place or remove Items from it
en.create.ponder.depot.text_3: Just like Mechanical Belts, it can provide items to processing
en.create.ponder.depot.text_4: ...as well as provide Items to Mechanical Arms
en.create.ponder.display_board.text_1: Display Boards are a scalable alternative to the sign
en.create.ponder.display_board.text_2: They require Rotational Force to operate
en.create.ponder.display_board.text_3: Static text can be applied using written Clipboards
en.create.ponder.display_board.text_4: And dynamic text through the use of Display Links
en.create.ponder.display_board.text_5: Dyes can be applied to individual lines of the board
en.create.ponder.display_board.text_6: Lines can be reset by clicking them with an empty hand
en.create.ponder.display_link.text_1: Display Links can be used to visualise dynamic information
en.create.ponder.display_link.text_3: ...then attach it to the block to read from
en.create.ponder.display_link.text_4: Open the Interface to select and configure what is sent
en.create.ponder.display_link.text_5: The display will now receive information from the link
en.create.ponder.display_link.text_6: Not every block can act as a source
en.create.ponder.display_link.text_7: Each compatible block provides unique information
en.create.ponder.display_link.text_8: The Display Link can work with several different displays
en.create.ponder.display_link_redstone.head: Redstone Control
en.create.ponder.display_link_redstone.text: When powered by Redstone, Display Links stop sending updates
Once unpowered, the Timer is reset and new info is sent immediately
Signals emitted from the source do not affect the Link
en.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_1: Elevator Pulleys can move structures vertically between marked locations
en.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_10: Any redstone contact sharing this column will be converted
en.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_11: Supply a redstone pulse to call the elevator to the contact
en.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_12: The movement speed depends on the rotation input on the pulley
en.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_13: Scroll and click on the controls block to choose a floor while on-board
en.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_14: Right-Clicking the assembled pulley will turn the cabin back into blocks
en.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_15: Sliding doors attached to the cabin will open and close automatically
en.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_16: Elevator Contacts emit a signal while the cabin is on their floor
en.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_17: This can be useful to trigger doors or special effects upon arrival
en.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_18: Display Links on any of the contacts can show the current floor of the elevator
en.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_3: Place a pair of Redstone Contacts facing each other...
en.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_4: ...and glue one of them to your moving structure
en.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_5: Contraption Controls can be attached to make floor selection easier
en.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_6: Ensure that the pulley is supplied with Rotational Power
en.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_7: Right-Clicking the pulley assembles the elevator
en.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_8: The stationary contact now turns into an Elevator Contact
en.create.ponder.elevator_pulley.text_9: Elevator Contacts represent a 'floor' and can be configured
en.create.ponder.elevator_pulley_multi_rope: Whenever a pulley assembles a contraption...
...other pulleys on the same layer will connect to the structure
They do not require to be powered, the effect is purely cosmetic
en.create.ponder.empty_blaze_burner.text_1: Right-click a Blaze with the empty burner to capture it
en.create.ponder.empty_blaze_burner.text_2: Alternatively, Blazes can be collected from their Spawners directly
en.create.ponder.empty_blaze_burner.text_3: You now have an ideal heat source for various machines
en.create.ponder.empty_blaze_burner.text_4: For Aesthetic purposes, Empty Blaze Burners can also be lit using Flint and Steel
en.create.ponder.empty_blaze_burner.text_5: The flame can be transformed using a soul-infused item
en.create.ponder.empty_blaze_burner.text_6: However, without a blaze they are not suitable for industrial heating
en.create.ponder.encased_fluid_pipe.text_1: Copper Casing can be used to decorate Fluid Pipes
en.create.ponder.encased_fluid_pipe.text_2: Aside from being concealed, Encased Pipes are locked into their connectivity state
en.create.ponder.encased_fluid_pipe.text_3: It will no longer react to any neighbouring blocks being added or removed
en.create.ponder.factory_gauge_crafting.tex: Factory gauges provide auto-arrangement for crafting table recipes
Connect the required ingredients as before
When a valid recipe is detected, a new button appears in the UI
With auto-arrangement active, the boxes can be unwrapped into crafters directly
The setup must be 3x3 and the crafters have to be connected via wrench
Hold Right-click on the gauge to set the target amount
This crafter can now be used universally, by more gauges with different recipes
Outputs should be sent back to a linked inventory to close the loop
Using a Re-packager is recommended to prevent fragmentation of input packages
en.create.ponder.factory_gauge_links.text_1: When adding a new connection from the UI...
en.create.ponder.factory_gauge_links.text_2: ...the gauge also accepts Redstone and Display Links
en.create.ponder.factory_gauge_links.text_3: Redstone links will be powered when the stock level is at or above the target amount
en.create.ponder.factory_gauge_links.text_4: In receiver mode, links can stop the gauge from sending requests
en.create.ponder.factory_gauge_links.text_5: Display links can provide a status overview of connected gauges
en.create.ponder.factory_gauge_recipe.text_: Whenever gauges are not placed on a packager...
Specify the address that ingredients should be sent to
The target amount to maintain can now be set by holding Right-click on the gauge
Whenever the network has fewer items than the amount...
...it will send new ingredients to the specified address
The outputs then need to return to any of the linked inventories
Green connections indicate that the target amount has been reached
The board of gauges can expand to include more recipe steps
Each gauge maintains the stock level of its item independently
They will instead monitor stock levels of all linked inventories
Right-click it with the item that should be monitored
It will now display the total amount present on the network
The gauge can replenish stock levels by sending other items to be processed
First, add the required ingredients as new factory gauges
From the target's UI, new connections can be made
For aesthetics, input panels can be wrenched to change the pathing
In the UI, review the inputs and specify how much of the output gets made per batch
en.create.ponder.factory_gauge_restocker.te: Right-click a Stock link before placement to connect to its network
...the logistics network sends more, with the specified address
From there, they can be routed to the packager
When placed on a packager, factory gauges can monitor items inside the inventory
Right-click it with the item that should be monitored
It will now display the amount present in the inventory
The gauge can refill this inventory from the logistics network
Right-click it again to open its configuration UI
Set an address that should be used for the requested items
The target amount to maintain can now be set by holding Right-click on the gauge
Whenever the chest has fewer items than this amount...
en.create.ponder.fan_direction.text_1: Encased Fans use Rotational Force to create an Air Current
en.create.ponder.fan_direction.text_2: Strength and Direction of Flow depends on the Rotational Input
en.create.ponder.fan_processing.text_1: When passing through lava, the Air Flow becomes Heated
en.create.ponder.fan_processing.text_2: Items caught in the area will be smelted
en.create.ponder.fan_processing.text_3: Food items thrown here would be incinerated
en.create.ponder.fan_processing.text_4: Instead, a setup for Smoking using Fire should be used for them
en.create.ponder.fan_processing.text_5: Air Flows passing through water create a Washing Setup
en.create.ponder.fan_processing.text_6: Some interesting new processing can be done with it
en.create.ponder.fan_processing.text_7: The Speed of the Fan does NOT affect the processing speed, only its range
en.create.ponder.fan_processing.text_8: Fan Processing can also be applied to Items on Depots and Belts
en.create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_1: Fluid Pipes can connect two or more fluid sources and targets
en.create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_2: Using a wrench, a straight pipe segment can be given a window
en.create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_3: Windowed pipes will not connect to any other adjacent pipe segments
en.create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_4: Powered by Mechanical Pumps, the Pipes can transport Fluids
en.create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_5: No fluid is being extracted at first
en.create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_6: Once the flow connects them, the endpoints gradually transfer their contents
en.create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_7: Thus, the Pipe blocks themselves never 'physically' contain any fluid
en.create.ponder.fluid_pipe_interaction.tex: Endpoints of a pipe network can interact with a variety of blocks
Any block with fluid storage capabilities can be filled or drained
Source blocks right in front of an open end can be picked up...
...while spilling into empty spaces can create fluid sources
Pipes can also extract fluids from a handful of other blocks directly
en.create.ponder.fluid_tank_sizes.text_1: Fluid Tanks can be combined to increase the total capacity
en.create.ponder.fluid_tank_sizes.text_2: Their base square can be up to 3 blocks wide...
en.create.ponder.fluid_tank_sizes.text_3: ...and grow in height by more than 30 additional layers
en.create.ponder.fluid_tank_sizes.text_4: Using a Wrench, a tanks' window can be toggled
en.create.ponder.fluid_tank_storage.text_1: Fluid Tanks can be used to store large amounts of fluid
en.create.ponder.fluid_tank_storage.text_2: Pipe networks can push and pull fluids from any side
en.create.ponder.fluid_tank_storage.text_3: The contained fluid can be measured by a Comparator
en.create.ponder.fluid_tank_storage.text_4: However, in Survival Mode Fluids cannot be added or taken manually
en.create.ponder.fluid_tank_storage.text_5: You can use Basins, Item Drains and Spouts to drain or fill fluid containing items
en.create.ponder.funnel_compat.text_1: Funnels should also interact nicely with a handful of other components.
en.create.ponder.funnel_direction.text_1: Placed normally, it pulls items from the inventory.
en.create.ponder.funnel_direction.text_2: Placed while sneaking, it puts items into the inventory.
en.create.ponder.funnel_direction.text_3: Using a wrench, the funnel can be flipped after placement.
en.create.ponder.funnel_direction.text_4: Same rules will apply for most orientations.
en.create.ponder.funnel_direction.text_5: Funnels on belts will extract/insert depending on its movement direction.
en.create.ponder.funnel_intro.text_1: Funnels are ideal for transferring items from and to inventories.
en.create.ponder.funnel_redstone.text_1: Redstone power will prevent any funnel from acting
en.create.ponder.funnel_transfer.text_1: Funnels cannot ever transfer between closed inventories directly.
en.create.ponder.funnel_transfer.text_2: Chutes or Smart chutes might be more suitable for such purposes.
en.create.ponder.funnel_transfer.text_3: Same applies for horizontal movement. A mechanical belt should help here.
en.create.ponder.gantry_carriage.text_1: Gantry Carriages can mount to and slide along a Gantry Shaft.
en.create.ponder.gantry_carriage.text_2: Gantry setups can move attached Blocks.
en.create.ponder.gantry_cascaded.text_1: Gantry shafts attach to a carriage without the need of super glue
en.create.ponder.gantry_cascaded.text_2: Same applies for carriages on moved Gantry Shafts
en.create.ponder.gantry_cascaded.text_3: Thus, a gantry system can be cascaded to cover multiple axes of movement
en.create.ponder.gantry_direction.text_1: Gantry Shafts can have opposite orientations
en.create.ponder.gantry_direction.text_2: The movement direction of carriages depend on their shafts' orientation
en.create.ponder.gantry_direction.text_3: ...as well as the rotation direction of the shaft
en.create.ponder.gantry_direction.text_4: Same rules apply for the propagated rotation
en.create.ponder.gantry_redstone.text_1: Redstone-powered gantry shafts stop moving their carriages
en.create.ponder.gantry_redstone.text_2: Instead, its rotational force is relayed to the carriages' output shaft
en.create.ponder.gantry_shaft.text_1: Gantry Shafts form the basis of a gantry setup. Attached Carriages will move along them.
en.create.ponder.gantry_shaft.text_2: Gantry setups can move attached Blocks.
en.create.ponder.gearbox.text_1: Jumping between axes of rotation can get bulky quickly
en.create.ponder.gearbox.text_2: A gearbox is the more compact equivalent of this setup
en.create.ponder.gearbox.text_3: Shafts around corners rotate in mirrored directions
en.create.ponder.gearshift.header: Controlling rotational force using a Gearshift
en.create.ponder.gearshift.text_1: Gearshifts will relay rotation in a straight line
en.create.ponder.gearshift.text_2: When powered by Redstone, it reverses the transmission
en.create.ponder.hand_crank.header: Generating Rotational Force using Hand Cranks
en.create.ponder.hand_crank.text_1: Hand Cranks can be used by players to apply rotational force manually
en.create.ponder.hand_crank.text_2: Hold Right-Click to rotate it Counter-Clockwise
en.create.ponder.hand_crank.text_3: Sneak and Hold Right-Click to rotate it Clockwise
en.create.ponder.hose_pulley.header: Source Filling and Draining using Hose Pulleys
en.create.ponder.hose_pulley.text_1: Hose Pulleys can be used to fill or drain large bodies of Fluid
en.create.ponder.hose_pulley.text_2: With the Kinetic Input, the height of the pulleys' hose can be controlled
en.create.ponder.hose_pulley.text_3: The Pulley retracts while the input rotation is inverted
en.create.ponder.hose_pulley.text_4: On the opposite side, pipes can be connected
en.create.ponder.hose_pulley.text_5: Attached pipe networks can either provide fluid to the hose...
en.create.ponder.hose_pulley.text_6: ...or pull from it, draining the pool instead
en.create.ponder.hose_pulley.text_7: Fill and Drain speed of the pulley depends entirely on the fluid networks' throughput
en.create.ponder.hose_pulley_infinite.heade: Passively Filling and Draining large bodies of Fluid
en.create.ponder.hose_pulley_infinite.text_: When deploying the Hose Pulley into a large enough ocean...
It will provide/dispose fluids without affecting the source
Pipe networks can limitlessly take fluids from/to such pulleys
en.create.ponder.hose_pulley_level.header: Fill and Drain level of Hose Pulleys
en.create.ponder.hose_pulley_level.text_1: While fully retracted, the Hose Pulley cannot operate
en.create.ponder.hose_pulley_level.text_2: Draining runs from top to bottom
en.create.ponder.hose_pulley_level.text_3: The surface level will end up just below where the hose ends
en.create.ponder.hose_pulley_level.text_4: Filling runs from bottom to top
en.create.ponder.hose_pulley_level.text_5: The filled pool will not grow beyond the layer above the hose end
en.create.ponder.item_drain.header: Emptying Fluid Containers using Item Drains
en.create.ponder.item_drain.text_1: Item Drains can extract fluids from items
en.create.ponder.item_drain.text_2: Right-click it to pour fluids from your held item into it
en.create.ponder.item_drain.text_3: When items are inserted from the side...
en.create.ponder.item_drain.text_4: ...they roll across, emptying out their contained fluid
en.create.ponder.item_drain.text_5: Pipe Networks can now pull the fluid from the drains' internal buffer
en.create.ponder.item_vault_sizes.text_1: Item Vaults can be combined to increase the total capacity
en.create.ponder.item_vault_sizes.text_2: Their base square can be up to 3 blocks wide...
en.create.ponder.item_vault_sizes.text_3: ...and grow in length up to 3x their diameter
en.create.ponder.item_vault_storage.text_1: Item Vaults can be used to store large amounts of items
en.create.ponder.item_vault_storage.text_2: However, contents cannot be added or taken manually
en.create.ponder.item_vault_storage.text_3: Any components for item transfer can both insert...
en.create.ponder.large_cogwheel.header: Relaying rotational force using Large Cogwheels
en.create.ponder.large_cogwheel.text_1: Large cogwheels can connect to each other at right angles
en.create.ponder.large_cogwheel.text_2: It will help relaying conveyed speed to other axes of rotation
en.create.ponder.large_water_wheel.header: Generating Rotational Force using Large Water Wheels
en.create.ponder.large_water_wheel.text_1: Large Water Wheels draw force from adjacent Water Currents
en.create.ponder.large_water_wheel.text_2: Covering additional sides will not improve its kinetic output further
en.create.ponder.large_water_wheel.text_3: These rotate only at half the speed of regular water wheels...
en.create.ponder.large_water_wheel.text_4: ...but provide a substantially higher stress capacity
en.create.ponder.large_water_wheel.text_5: Use wood planks on the wheel to change its appearance
The open faces of a Linear Chassis can be made Sticky
Click again to make the opposite side sticky
Sneak and Right-Click with an empty hand to remove the slime
Stickied faces of the Linear Chassis will attach a line of blocks in front of it
Using a Wrench, a precise Range can be specified for this chassis
Holding CTRL adjusts the range of all connected Chassis Blocks
Attaching blocks to any other side requires the use of Super Glue
Using these mechanics, structures of any shape can move as a Contraption
en.create.ponder.linear_chassis_group.text_: Linear Chassis connect to identical Chassis blocks next to them
When one is moved by a Contraption, the others are dragged with it
Chassis of a different type or facing another direction will not attach
en.create.ponder.mechanical_arm.text_1: Mechanical Arms have to be assigned their in- and outputs before they are placed
en.create.ponder.mechanical_arm.text_2: Right-Click inventories while holding the Arm to assign them as Targets
en.create.ponder.mechanical_arm.text_3: Right-Click again to toggle between Input (Blue) and Output (Yellow)
en.create.ponder.mechanical_arm.text_4: Left-Click components to remove their Selection
en.create.ponder.mechanical_arm.text_5: Once placed, the Mechanical Arm will target the blocks selected previously
en.create.ponder.mechanical_arm.text_6: They can have any amount of in- and outputs within their range
en.create.ponder.mechanical_arm.text_7: However, not every type of Inventory can be interacted with directly
en.create.ponder.mechanical_arm.text_8: Funnels and Depots can help to Bridge that gap
en.create.ponder.mechanical_arm_filtering.h: Filtering Outputs of the Mechanical Arm
en.create.ponder.mechanical_arm_filtering.t: Sometimes it is desirable to restrict targets of the Arm by matching a filter
Mechanical Arms by themselves do not provide any options for filtering
Brass Funnels as Targets do however communicate their own filter to the Arm
The Arm is smart enough not to pick up items it couldn't distribute
en.create.ponder.mechanical_arm_modes.heade: Distribution modes of the Mechanical Arm
en.create.ponder.mechanical_arm_modes.text_: Whenever an Arm has to choose between multiple valid outputs...
...it will act according to its setting
The value panel will allow you to configure it
Round Robin mode simply cycles through all outputs that are available
If an output is unable to take more items, it will be skipped
Forced Round Robin mode will never skip outputs, and instead wait until they are free
Prefer First prioritizes the outputs selected earliest when configuring this Arm
en.create.ponder.mechanical_arm_redstone.te: When powered by Redstone, Mechanical Arms will not activate
Before stopping, it will finish any started cycles
Thus, a negative pulse can be used to trigger exactly one activation cycle
en.create.ponder.mechanical_bearing.header: Moving Structures using the Mechanical Bearing
en.create.ponder.mechanical_bearing.text_1: Mechanical Bearings attach to the block in front of them
en.create.ponder.mechanical_bearing.text_2: Upon receiving Rotational Force, it will assemble it into a Rotating Contraption
en.create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_1: An array of Mechanical Crafters can be used to automate any Crafting Recipe
en.create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_2: Using a Wrench, the Crafters' paths can be arranged
en.create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_3: For a valid setup, all paths have to converge into one exit at any side
en.create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_4: The outputs will be placed into the inventory at the exit
en.create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_5: Mechanical Crafters require Rotational Force to operate
en.create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_6: Right-Click the front to insert Items manually
en.create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_7: Once every slot of a path contains an Item, the crafting process will begin
en.create.ponder.mechanical_crafter.text_8: For recipes not fully occupying the crafter setup, the start can be forced using a Redstone Pulse
en.create.ponder.mechanical_crafter_connect: Items can be inserted to Crafters automatically
Using the Wrench at their backs, Mechanical Crafter inputs can be combined
All connected Crafters can now be accessed by the same input location
Some recipes will require additional Crafters to bridge gaps in the path
Using Slot Covers, Crafters can be set to act as an Empty Slot in the arrangement
Shared Inputs created with the Wrench at the back can also reach across covered Crafters
en.create.ponder.mechanical_drill.header: Breaking Blocks with the Mechanical Drill
en.create.ponder.mechanical_drill.text_1: When given Rotational Force, a Mechanical Drill will break blocks directly in front of it
en.create.ponder.mechanical_drill.text_2: Its mining speed depends on the Rotational Input
en.create.ponder.mechanical_drill_contrapti: Whenever Drills are moved as part of an animated Contraption...
...they will break blocks the contraption runs them into
en.create.ponder.mechanical_harvester.text_: Whenever Harvesters are moved as part of an animated Contraption...
They will harvest and reset any mature crops on their way
en.create.ponder.mechanical_mixer.header: Processing Items with the Mechanical Mixer
en.create.ponder.mechanical_mixer.text_1: With a Mixer and Basin, some Crafting Recipes can be automated
en.create.ponder.mechanical_mixer.text_2: Available recipes include any Shapeless Crafting Recipe, plus a couple extra ones
en.create.ponder.mechanical_mixer.text_3: Some of those recipes may require the heat of a Blaze Burner
en.create.ponder.mechanical_mixer.text_4: The filter slot can be used in case two recipes are conflicting.
en.create.ponder.mechanical_piston.text_1: Mechanical Pistons can move blocks in front of them
en.create.ponder.mechanical_piston.text_2: Speed and direction of movement depend on the Rotational Input
en.create.ponder.mechanical_piston.text_3: Sticky Mechanical Pistons can pull the attached blocks back
en.create.ponder.mechanical_piston_modes.he: Movement Modes of the Mechanical Piston
en.create.ponder.mechanical_piston_modes.te: Whenever Pistons stop moving, the moved structure reverts to blocks
It can be configured never to revert to solid blocks, or only at the location it started at
en.create.ponder.mechanical_plough.text_1: Whenever Ploughs are moved as part of an animated Contraption...
en.create.ponder.mechanical_plough.text_2: ...they will break blocks without a solid collision hitbox
en.create.ponder.mechanical_plough.text_4: ...they can also launch entities without hurting them
en.create.ponder.mechanical_press.header: Processing Items with the Mechanical Press
en.create.ponder.mechanical_press.text_1: The Mechanical Press can process items provided beneath it
en.create.ponder.mechanical_press.text_2: The Input items can be dropped or placed on a Depot under the Press
en.create.ponder.mechanical_press.text_3: When items are provided on a belt...
en.create.ponder.mechanical_press.text_4: The Press will hold and process them automatically
en.create.ponder.mechanical_press_compactin: Compacting items with the Mechanical Press
Pressing items held in a Basin will cause them to be Compacted
Compacting includes any filled 2x2 or 3x3 Crafting Recipe, plus a couple extra ones
Some of those recipes may require the heat of a Blaze Burner
The filter slot can be used in case two recipes are conflicting.
en.create.ponder.mechanical_pump_flow.text_: Mechanical Pumps govern the flow of their attached pipe networks
Their arrow indicates the direction of flow
The network behind is now pulling fluids...
...while the network in front is transferring it outward
The pumps direction is unaffected by the input rotation
Instead, a Wrench can be used to reverse the direction
en.create.ponder.mechanical_pump_speed.head: Throughput of Mechanical Pumps
en.create.ponder.mechanical_pump_speed.text: Regardless of speed, Mechanical Pumps affect pipes connected up to 16 blocks away
Speeding up the input rotation changes the speed of flow propagation...
...and the speed at which fluids are transferred
Pumps can combine their throughputs within shared pipe networks
Ensure that all of them are facing in the same direction
en.create.ponder.mechanical_roller_fill.tex: While disassembled, rollers can be set to other modes
The 'fill' modes can help to bridge gaps between pavement and terrain
On 'straight fill', they will place simple columns down to the surface
On 'sloped fill', layers placed further down will increase in size
As opposed to 'clear & pave', neither of these modes will cause the rollers to break existing blocks
en.create.ponder.mechanical_roller_pave.hea: Clearing and Paving with the Roller
en.create.ponder.mechanical_roller_pave.tex: Mechanical rollers help to clean up terrain around tracks or paths
In its default mode, without a material set, it will simply clear blocks like a Drill
While disassembled, a suitable paving material can be specified
Materials can be supplied via chests or barrels attached to the structure
In addition to breaking blocks, it will now replace the layer beneath them
Note that any block destroyed by a roller has a chance not to yield drops
Rollers are especially useful on Trains, but can also be used on most other types of moving contraptions
en.create.ponder.mechanical_saw_breaker.hea: Cutting Trees with the Mechanical Saw
en.create.ponder.mechanical_saw_breaker.tex: When given Rotational Force, a Mechanical Saw will cut trees directly in front of it
In order to cut the tree fully, the Saw has to break the last block connecting it to the ground
en.create.ponder.mechanical_saw_contraption: Whenever Saws are moved as part of an animated Contraption...
...they will cut any trees the contraption runs them into
Processing Items on the Mechanical Saw
Upward facing Mechanical Saws can process a variety of items
The processed item always moves against the rotational input to the saw
Saws can work in-line with Mechanical Belts
When an ingredient has multiple possible outcomes, the filter slot can specify it
Without filter, the Saw would cycle through all outcomes instead
en.create.ponder.millstone.text_1: Millstones process items by grinding them
en.create.ponder.millstone.text_2: They can be powered from the side using cogwheels
en.create.ponder.millstone.text_3: Throw or Insert items at the top
en.create.ponder.millstone.text_4: After some time, the result can be obtained via Right-click
en.create.ponder.millstone.text_5: The outputs can also be extracted by automation
en.create.ponder.nixie_tube.text_1: When powered by Redstone, Nixie Tubes will display the signal strength
en.create.ponder.nixie_tube.text_2: Using written Clipboards, custom text can be displayed
en.create.ponder.nixie_tube.text_3: Right-Click with Dye to change their display colour
en.create.ponder.package_frogport.text_1: Right-click a Chain Conveyor and place the Frogport nearby
en.create.ponder.package_frogport.text_10: Packages find their path to a matching frog on the chain network
en.create.ponder.package_frogport.text_13: Frogports can directly interface with inventories below them
en.create.ponder.package_frogport.text_14: This also works with packagers. Items can be packed and shipped directly
en.create.ponder.package_frogport.text_18: Right-click Frogports with a clipboard to collect their address
en.create.ponder.package_frogport.text_19: Clipboards with collected names can help auto-complete address inputs in other UIs
en.create.ponder.package_frogport.text_2: Assign it an address in the inventory UI
en.create.ponder.package_frogport.text_3: If the address of an inserted package does not match it..
en.create.ponder.package_frogport.text_6: ..the Frogport will place the package on the conveyor
en.create.ponder.package_frogport.text_7: Packages spin in place if they have no valid destination
en.create.ponder.package_frogport.text_8: More Frogports can be added anywhere on the chain network
en.create.ponder.packager.text_1: Attach packagers to the inventory they should target
en.create.ponder.packager.text_2: Given redstone power, it will pack items from the inventory into a package
en.create.ponder.packager.text_3: These can be picked up and transported like any other item
en.create.ponder.packager.text_4: Packages inserted will be destroyed, unpacking the contents into the inventory
en.create.ponder.packager.text_6: Packagers will not accept packages they cannot fully unpack
en.create.ponder.packager_address.text_10: For compactness, mechanical saws can unpack straight onto a belt
en.create.ponder.packager_address.text_11: Aside from filters, Frogports and Postboxes have package routing abilities
en.create.ponder.packager_address.text_12: Inspect them to find out more about their behaviour
en.create.ponder.packager_address.text_2: When a sign is placed on a packager..
en.create.ponder.packager_address.text_4: Created packages will carry the written lines of text as their address
en.create.ponder.packager_address.text_5: Package filters route packages based on their address
en.create.ponder.piston_pole.text_1: Without attached Poles, a Mechanical Piston cannot move
en.create.ponder.piston_pole.text_2: The Length of pole added at its back determines the Extension Range
en.create.ponder.portable_fluid_interface.t: Fluid Tanks on moving contraptions cannot be accessed by any pipes
This component can interact with fluid tanks without the need to stop the contraption
Place a second one with a gap of 1 or 2 blocks inbetween
Whenever they pass by each other, they will engage in a connection
While engaged, the stationary interface will represent ALL Tanks on the contraption
After no contents have been exchanged for a while, the contraption will continue on its way
en.create.ponder.portable_storage_interface: Moving inventories can be tricky to access with automation.
This component can interact with storage without the need to stop the contraption.
Place a second one with a gap of 1 or 2 blocks inbetween
Whenever they pass by each other, they will engage in a connection
While engaged, the stationary interface will represent ALL inventories on the contraption
After no items have been exchanged for a while, the contraption will continue on its way
Redstone power will prevent the stationary interface from engaging
en.create.ponder.postbox.text_1: Right-click a Train Station and place the Postbox nearby
en.create.ponder.postbox.text_11: Just like trains, Postboxes maintain their behaviour in unloaded chunks
en.create.ponder.postbox.text_12: Packages can still be delivered from or to their inventory
en.create.ponder.postbox.text_2: Assign it an address in the inventory UI
en.create.ponder.postbox.text_3: If the address of an inserted package does not match it..
en.create.ponder.postbox.text_6: ..trains stopping at the station will collect it as cargo
en.create.ponder.postbox.text_7: Conversely, packages matching the address will be dropped off
en.create.ponder.postbox.text_8: Packages that arrived by train can be extracted from the Postbox
en.create.ponder.powered_latch.header: Controlling signals using the Powered Latch
en.create.ponder.powered_latch.text_1: Powered Latches are redstone controllable Levers
en.create.ponder.powered_latch.text_2: Signals at the back switch it on
en.create.ponder.powered_latch.text_3: Signals from the side switch it back off
en.create.ponder.powered_latch.text_4: Powered latches can also be toggled manually
en.create.ponder.powered_toggle_latch.heade: Controlling signals using the Powered Toggle Latch
en.create.ponder.powered_toggle_latch.text_: Powered Toggle Latches are redstone controllable Levers
Signals at the back will toggle its state
Powered toggle latches can also be toggled manually
en.create.ponder.pulse_extender.text_1: Pulse Extenders can lengthen a signal passing through
en.create.ponder.pulse_extender.text_2: They activate after a short delay...
en.create.ponder.pulse_extender.text_3: ...and cool down for the configured duration
en.create.ponder.pulse_extender.text_4: Using the value panel, the discharge time can be configured
en.create.ponder.pulse_extender.text_5: The configured duration can range up to an hour
en.create.ponder.pulse_repeater.text_1: Pulse Repeaters emit a short pulse after a delay
en.create.ponder.pulse_repeater.text_2: Using the value panel, the charge time can be configured
en.create.ponder.pulse_repeater.text_3: Configured delays can range up to an hour
en.create.ponder.pulse_timer.header: Redstone output of the Pulse Timer
en.create.ponder.pulse_timer.text_1: Pulse Timers repeatedly emit short pulses
en.create.ponder.pulse_timer.text_2: Using the value panel, the time interval can be configured
en.create.ponder.pulse_timer.text_3: Powering the input side will pause and reset them
en.create.ponder.pulse_timer.text_4: Right-click the circuit base to invert the output
en.create.ponder.pulse_timer.text_5: This helps trigger mechanisms that activate only without a redstone signal
en.create.ponder.radial_chassis.text_1: Radial Chassis connect to identical Chassis blocks in a row
en.create.ponder.radial_chassis.text_2: When one is moved by a Contraption, the others are dragged with it
en.create.ponder.radial_chassis.text_3: The side faces of a Radial Chassis can be made Sticky
en.create.ponder.radial_chassis.text_4: Click again to make all other sides sticky
en.create.ponder.radial_chassis.text_5: Sneak and Right-Click with an empty hand to remove the slime
en.create.ponder.radial_chassis.text_6: Whenever a Block is next to a sticky face...
en.create.ponder.radial_chassis.text_7: ...it will attach all reachable blocks within a radius on that layer
en.create.ponder.radial_chassis.text_8: Using a Wrench, a precise Radius can be specified for this chassis
en.create.ponder.radial_chassis.text_9: Blocks not reachable by any sticky face will not attach
en.create.ponder.redstone_contact.text_1: Redstone Contacts facing each other will emit a redstone signal
en.create.ponder.redstone_contact.text_2: This still applies when one of them is part of a moving Contraption
en.create.ponder.redstone_link.text_1: Redstone Links can transmit redstone signals wirelessly
en.create.ponder.redstone_link.text_2: Right-click while Sneaking to toggle receive mode
en.create.ponder.redstone_link.text_3: A simple Right-click with a Wrench can do the same
en.create.ponder.redstone_link.text_4: Receivers emit the redstone power of transmitters within 256 blocks
en.create.ponder.redstone_link.text_5: Placing items in the two slots can specify a Frequency
en.create.ponder.redstone_link.text_6: Only the links with matching Frequencies will communicate
en.create.ponder.redstone_requester.text_1: Right-click a Stock link before placement to connect to its network
en.create.ponder.redstone_requester.text_2: Just like Stock tickers, Redstone requesters can order items from the logistics network
en.create.ponder.redstone_requester.text_3: Right-click the requester to open its configuration UI
en.create.ponder.redstone_requester.text_4: The order set in the UI will be requested on every redstone pulse
en.create.ponder.redstone_requester.text_5: Alternatively, the requester can be fully configured before placement
en.create.ponder.redstone_requester.text_6: Right-click a Stock keeper with it and set the desired order there
en.create.ponder.repackager.text_1: Sometimes, it is crucial for logistical requests to arrive as a single package
en.create.ponder.repackager.text_4: Otherwise, other packages could arrive inbetween
en.create.ponder.repackager.text_5: When this is the case, redirect packages to an inventory
en.create.ponder.repackager.text_6: Attach a re-packager, and power it with redstone
en.create.ponder.repackager.text_7: Once all fragments arrived, they will be exported as a new package
en.create.ponder.repackager.text_8: Now, requested items arrive together and in a predictable order
en.create.ponder.rope_pulley.text_1: Rope Pulleys can move blocks vertically when given Rotational Force
en.create.ponder.rope_pulley.text_2: Direction and Speed of movement depend on the Rotational Input
en.create.ponder.rope_pulley_attachment.hea: Moving Pulleys as part of a Contraption
en.create.ponder.rope_pulley_attachment.tex: Whenever Pulleys are themselves being moved by a Contraption...
...its attached structure will be dragged with it
Mind that pulleys are only movable while stopped
en.create.ponder.rope_pulley_modes.header: Movement Modes of the Rope Pulley
en.create.ponder.rope_pulley_modes.text_1: Whenever Pulleys stop moving, the moved structure reverts to blocks
en.create.ponder.rope_pulley_modes.text_2: It can be configured never to revert to solid blocks, or only at the location it started at
en.create.ponder.rope_pulley_multi_rope.tex: Whenever a pulley assembles a contraption...
...other pulleys on the same layer will connect to the structure
They do not require to be powered, the effect is purely cosmetic
en.create.ponder.rose_quartz_lamp.text_1: Rose Quartz Lamps activate on a Redstone signal
en.create.ponder.rose_quartz_lamp.text_2: They will continue to emit redstone power afterwards
en.create.ponder.rose_quartz_lamp.text_3: When multiple lamps are arranged in a group...
en.create.ponder.rose_quartz_lamp.text_4: ...activating a Lamp will focus the signal to it, deactivating all others
en.create.ponder.rose_quartz_lamp.text_5: Comparators output based on the distance to a powered lamp
en.create.ponder.rose_quartz_lamp.text_6: The Lamps can also be toggled manually using a Wrench
Rot. Speed Controllers relay rotation from their axis to a Large Cogwheel above them
Using the value panel on its side, the conveyed speed can be configured
en.create.ponder.sail.text_1: Sails are handy blocks to create Windmills with
en.create.ponder.sail.text_2: They will attach to blocks and each other without the need of Super Glue or Chassis Blocks
en.create.ponder.sail.text_3: Right-Click with Dye to paint them
en.create.ponder.sail.text_4: Right-Click with Shears to turn them back into frames
en.create.ponder.sail_frame.text_1: Sail Frames are handy blocks to create Windmills with
en.create.ponder.sail_frame.text_2: They will attach to blocks and each other without the need of Super Glue or Chassis Blocks
en.create.ponder.sequenced_gearshift.header: Controlling Rotational Speed using Sequenced Gearshifts
en.create.ponder.sequenced_gearshift.text_1: Seq. Gearshifts relay rotation by following a timed list of instructions
en.create.ponder.sequenced_gearshift.text_2: Right-click it to open the Configuration UI
en.create.ponder.sequenced_gearshift.text_3: Upon receiving a Redstone Signal, it will start running its configured sequence
en.create.ponder.sequenced_gearshift.text_4: Once finished, it waits for the next Redstone Signal and starts over
en.create.ponder.sequenced_gearshift.text_5: A redstone comparator can be used to read the current progress
en.create.ponder.shaft.text_1: Shafts will relay rotation in a straight line.
en.create.ponder.shaft_casing.text_1: Brass or Andesite Casing can be used to decorate Shafts
en.create.ponder.shared.behaviour_modify_va: This behaviour can be modified using the value panel
en.create.ponder.shared.movement_anchors: With the help of Super Glue, larger structures can be moved.
en.create.ponder.shared.storage_on_contrapt: Inventories attached to the Contraption will pick up their drops automatically
en.create.ponder.smart_chute.text_1: Smart Chutes are vertical chutes with additional control
en.create.ponder.smart_chute.text_2: Items in the filter slot specify what to extract or transfer
en.create.ponder.smart_chute.text_3: Use the value panel to specify the extracted stack size
en.create.ponder.smart_chute.text_4: Redstone power will prevent Smart Chutes from acting.
en.create.ponder.smart_observer.text_1: Smart Observers can be used to detect a variety of events
en.create.ponder.smart_observer.text_2: It can detect items or fluids inside of generic containers
en.create.ponder.smart_observer.text_3: The filter slot can be used to look for specific contents only
en.create.ponder.smart_observer.text_4: It also activates when the block itself matches the filter
en.create.ponder.smart_observer.text_5: Additionally, smart observers can monitor belts, chutes and pipes
en.create.ponder.smart_observer.text_6: ...and will emit a pulse, if an item enters or exits a funnel
en.create.ponder.smart_pipe.header: Controlling Fluid flow using Smart Pipes
en.create.ponder.smart_pipe.text_1: Smart pipes can help control flows by fluid type
en.create.ponder.smart_pipe.text_2: When placed directly at the source, they can specify the type of fluid to extract
en.create.ponder.smart_pipe.text_3: Simply Right-Click their filter slot with any item containing the desired fluid
en.create.ponder.smart_pipe.text_4: When placed further down a pipe network, smart pipes will only let matching fluids continue
en.create.ponder.speedometer.header: Monitoring Kinetic information using the Speedometer
en.create.ponder.speedometer.text_1: The Speedometer displays the current Speed of attached components
en.create.ponder.speedometer.text_2: When wearing Engineers' Goggles, the player can get more detailed information from the Gauge
en.create.ponder.speedometer.text_3: Comparators can emit analog Redstone Signals relative to the Speedometer's measurements
en.create.ponder.spout_filling.text_1: The Spout can fill fluid holding items provided beneath it

en.create.ponder.train_signal_placement.tex: Select a Train Track then place the Signal nearby
Signals control the flow of Trains not driven by players
Scheduled Trains will never cross signals in the opposite direction
...unless a second signal is added facing the opposite way.
Nixie tubes can be attached to make a signal's lights more visible
en.create.ponder.train_signal_redstone.head: Signals & Redstone
en.create.ponder.train_signal_redstone.text: Signals can be forced red by a redstone signal
Conversely, red signals emit a comparator output
en.create.ponder.train_signal_signaling.tex: Train Signals divide a track into segments
If a Segment is occupied, no other Trains will be allowed entry
Thus, each Segment will contain only one Train at a time
A second Signal mode is available via the Wrench
Segments of a brass signal usually lead into standard signals
This special Signal can stop trains under a second condition
It will stop Trains, which, upon entering...
...would not be able to leave the Segment immediately
This helps keeping queued Trains out of a busy Segment

en.create.ponder.valve_handle.text_4: Sneak-Right-Click to activate it in the opposite direction

First, configure the Brass Tunnel to 'Prefer Nearest', in order to prioritize its side output
The Stack Size set on the Ejector now determines the amount to be split off
While a new stack of the configured size exits the side output...
...the remainder will continue on its path
